$comment: Single source of the non-secret variables of Omar's remote setup. No private key, token or public IP here: tokens travel out of band, the public address stays in host logs and ssh/omar.authorized_keys only.

sshWsl.note: WSL2 Ubuntu OpenSSH; Windows OpenSSH keeps port 22

reverseTunnel.$comment: Fallback while wg1 has no handshake: Omar's PC publishes its loopback services on the vps loopback (omar-sshd.conf PermitListen).

ownerAliases.omar-rt: ssh through the reverse tunnel (ProxyJump vps, 127.0.0.1:22010)
ownerAliases.omar-wsl: ssh over wg1 to the WSL Ubuntu (10.200.77.10 port 2222)
ownerAliases.omar-wsl-rt: ssh to the WSL Ubuntu through the reverse tunnel (ProxyJump vps, 127.0.0.1:22011)
